notes.a-paul-jones-honors-hall: OSM's 'A. Paul Jones Scholars Hall' (way/618409324, 120 Wright Street, a two-storey house); Carroll housing describes A. Paul Jones Honors Hall as the former Sigma Phi Epsilon house turned back into student housing in 2019 (carrollu.edu/campus-student-life/housing/traditional-halls).
notes.hartwell-avenue-apartments: Carroll housing: Hartwell Avenue Apartments are buildings Hartwell A–D (carrollu.edu/campus-student-life/housing/apartments/); OSM has Hartwell A–D at 324 North Hartwell Avenue. Pinned on Hartwell B (way/618548099).

detours.why: The Wright Street houses' mapped doors face Wright Street, and the block between College Avenue and Wright Street has no mapped path through, so walks go round by the streets.
